lines.text: A free GTA 6 PC download that's secretly a virus?
Rockstar hasn't announced any PC version.
But fake PC builds are spreading anyway.
TechRadar says one 113 gigabyte download is almost all empty zeroes, plus a tiny virus.
Malwarebytes found fake GTA 6 demo sites that lead to password-stealing malware.
Hackers love hype, and nothing has more hype than GTA 6.
If a site promises a free PC copy, that's the bait.
Only download games from stores you trust.
Never turn off your antivirus for a game.
